opinions.point: The episode was widely viewed as emotionally powerful, heartfelt, and beautiful.
Many commenters praised the central relationship and felt the characters’ emotional development was convincing.
The supporting cast and their compassion were repeatedly appreciated.
Several viewers found the ending especially moving and satisfying on an emotional level.
The intense emotional swings were effective for many viewers but exhausting or overwhelming for others.
Some reactions criticized how relentlessly painful and melodramatic the episode felt.
Viewers were divided between optimism and anxiety about the direction of the finale.
